annotation.title_clean: RBAC nº 100 Emenda nº 00 - Requisitos gerais para aeronaves não tripuladas de uso civil
annotation.title_en: Brazilian Civil Aviation Regulation RBAC No. 100, Amendment 00 - General requirements for civil unmanned aircraft
annotation.venue: ANAC - Regulamentos Brasileiros da Aviação Civil (RBAC)
annotation.summary_en: Brazil's ANAC regulation RBAC 100 (Amendment 00, June 2026) sets general requirements for civil unmanned aircraft. It establishes open, specific and certified operation categories based on operational risk, with remote pilot rules, design authorisation, airworthiness certificates, registration, operator registration (COE), mandatory third-party liability insurance and inspection.
key_provisions_or_claims: Three risk-based operating categories: open (≤25 kg, VLOS/EVLOS, ≤120 m), specific, and certified.
Remote pilot must be able to intervene at any phase of flight; one UA per pilot unless authorised.
Specific category requires standard scenario or ANAC-assessed operational risk and design authorisation.
All UA must be registered/cadastrated and linked to an operator; operators of specific category need a COE.
Third-party damage insurance mandatory, with exceptions for state entities and certain agricultural applications.
